description: This file defines classes and methods for testing the System Roles UI component in Mattermost's admin console, including role management, privilege settings, and assigned people panels.

classes.name: SystemRoles
classes.description: Represents the UI component for editing a system role, including header, privileges, assigned people, and actions.

classes.name: PrivilegesPanel
classes.description: Encapsulates the privileges section within the system role editing page, containing multiple permission sections.

classes.name: PermissionSection
classes.description: Represents a permission section within the privileges panel, allowing permission setting and subsection management.

classes.name: PermissionSubsection
classes.description: Represents a subsection within a permission section, allowing permission adjustments.

classes.name: AssignedPeoplePanel
classes.description: Handles the assigned people list, including adding, searching, and removing users.

classes.name: AssignedUserRow
classes.description: Represents a row in the assigned people list, with user details and removal action.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the UI component is visible.

methods.name: getPermissionValue
methods.description: Gets the current permission value for a section or subsection.

methods.name: setPermission
methods.description: Sets the permission level for a section or subsection.

methods.name: getSubsection
methods.description: Retrieves a specific subsection by name.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Checks if the permission section or subsection is visible.

methods.name: getUserCount
methods.description: Returns the number of assigned users.

methods.name: getUserRowByIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a user row by index.

methods.name: getUserRowByUsername
methods.description: Retrieves a user row by username.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the user from the assigned list.
